## Permissions

| Permission | Default | Description |
|------------|---------|-------------|
| `plugin.use` | `true` | Basic usage |
| `plugin.admin` | `op` | Admin commands |
| `plugin.bypass` | `op` | Bypass restrictions |

### LuckPerms Setup
```bash
# Basic user
/lp group default permission set plugin.use true

# Admin
/lp group admin permission set plugin.admin true
/lp group admin permission set plugin.bypass true
```
